name: sony-camera-bridge
description: Universal camera-control bridge: one software RCP + touch PTZ panel and a normalizing command bus for Sony, Canon, Panasonic, Blackmagic, Z CAM, JVC, BirdDog and generic VISCA PTZ cameras — with Bitfocus Companion and USB control-panel input.

scripts.dev: npm run bridge & npm run web
scripts.electron:build: npm run build --workspace=packages/web-rcp && npm run dist --workspace=packages/electron-app
scripts.electron:dist: npm run build --workspace=packages/web-rcp && npm run dist:win --workspace=packages/electron-app
